article.headline: Finister’s 12 lead Charlotte past FGCU 71-58
article.description: — Dorian Finister had 12 points in Charlotte’s 71-58 victory over FGCU on Monday.
article.story: CYPRESS LAKE, Fla. -- — Dorian Finister had 12 points in Charlotte’s 71-58 victory over FGCU on Monday. Finister added five rebounds for the 49ers (4-2). Arden Conyers scored 11 points, shooting 4 for 7, including 3 for 6 from beyond the arc. Bryson Lucas finished with 13 points and three steals for the Eagles (2-5). Darren Williams added 12 points for FGCU. Charlotte took the lead for good with 18:39 remaining in the first half. The score was 37-29 at halftime, with Conyers racking up nine points. Charlotte pulled away with a 14-3 run in the second half to extend a nine-point lead to 20 points. Peyton Marshall led the way with a team-high eight second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
